digest.component_or_area: CLI parser and route registry foundation
propositions: A narrow factory protocol and immutable route registry must encode all current CLI spellings and derive compatibility policy exports without importing handlers or optional dependencies.

Route records must support lazy handler/parser-factory references, identity/alias/visibility/help metadata, and capability constraints, with deterministic validation of duplicates, contradictions, alias/retired collisions, and malformed references.

The custom ArgumentParser and formatter must produce deterministic help output, fixed-width formatting independent of terminal, UTF-8 LF with trailing newline, and compatibility-shaped parse errors without process termination.
Registry validation and route lookup must provably not import handlers or optional packages, enforced via subprocess isolation in unit tests.
Existing help files and execution paths remain unchanged; no public behavior changes occur and rollback requires only removal of unused scaffolding.
